high_level_description: This image captures a serene sunset scene on a multi-lane road. The sky is painted with hues of orange, yellow, and a hint of pink near the horizon, indicating that the sun is either rising or setting. The sun itself is partially obscured by the silhouette of a mountain range in the background, adding depth to the composition. The road is divided into multiple lanes, marked by white dashed lines, and bordered by a black and white striped barrier on the right side. The barrier appears to be a safety feature, possibly for separating traffic directions or marking the edge of the road.
